audit_scope: Scratch audit for official/public sources used to identify architecture-related observed-change candidates.

sources.license_and_terms: BCC copyright page reserves rights and restricts redistribution/commercial exploitation without express permission. Use links and short factual extraction only unless reuse permission is clarified.
sources.coverage_years: Completed and underway Belfast Urban Villages capital projects; page states 29 projects completed since 2019.
sources.update_frequency: Not stated; appears maintained as a current council project page.
sources.geographic_scope: Belfast Urban Villages areas and named project sites.
sources.granularity: Project-level summary; some projects have links to more detailed pages, others only names/roads.
sources.required_caveats: Exact completion dates and coordinates are often absent; use broad date ranges and approximate geometry until project-specific pages or planning records are found.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Keep as candidate source for project discovery; before production ingest, resolve exact dates, addresses, geometry and license permission.
next_checks: Open linked project pages for individual parks where available.
Cross-check completion dates against council committee reports or press releases.
Replace approximate geocoding with planning/GIS parcel geometry if possible.

sources.source_name: Belfast City Council capital programme, leisure and heritage project pages
sources.license_and_terms: BCC copyright restrictions apply; cite and link rather than republishing page text.
sources.coverage_years: Council-owned facility investment, including leisure transformations from 2017 onward and current heritage/public realm projects.
sources.update_frequency: Not stated; project pages are current web pages.
sources.geographic_scope: Council facilities and public realm sites across Belfast.
sources.granularity: Project page level, usually with opening year/month or current project status.
sources.reliability_assessment: strong for council-owned project facts, usable with caveats for precise geometry
sources.required_caveats: Some pages expose a 'Location' heading without coordinate text in accessible HTML; geometry must be independently verified.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Good candidate source for documented facility changes; use exact opening dates only when stated.
next_checks: Confirm BCC terms for derived factual datasets.
Use council GIS/open data if a facility coordinate dataset is available.
Split multi-component projects into separate records only if sources support it.

sources.source_name: Department for Infrastructure transport news releases
sources.license_and_terms: Crown copyright; DfI copyright page says material may be used and reused under Open Government Licence v3.0 except logos and third-party material.
sources.coverage_years: Transport infrastructure news through access date, including Belfast Transport Hub / Grand Central Station and Colin Hub milestones.
sources.geographic_scope: Northern Ireland; individual releases include Belfast project locations.
sources.granularity: Milestone-level press releases with dates and project descriptions.
sources.required_caveats: Press releases may describe future benefits; only record observed milestones such as start, opening phase, or public realm phase opening.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use for transport-hub event candidates with OGL attribution.
next_checks: For geometry, use planning application documents or Translink plans instead of candidate geocoding.
Separate phased openings from full completion.

sources.source_name: Queen's University Belfast Estates Completed Projects
sources.license_and_terms: University website terms/copyright not confirmed in this scratch pass; use links and short factual extraction pending terms review.
sources.coverage_years: Capital development completed projects visible on page, including 2016 through 2025 entries.
sources.update_frequency: Not stated; appears maintained as an estates portfolio page.
sources.geographic_scope: Queen's University Belfast estate, mostly south Belfast plus city-centre accommodation.
sources.granularity: Project-level entries with completed month/year and scope narrative.
sources.reliability_assessment: strong for university estates completion facts, usable with caveats for license/geometry
sources.required_caveats: Many entries are internal refurbishments; map display must distinguish internal works from new build or public realm. Coordinates are approximate unless separately sourced.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: High-signal source for education/health-adjacent built-environment changes; production ingest should add terms review and authoritative campus coordinates.
next_checks: Cross-check high-profile projects against QUB news releases for exact opening dates.
Use campus asset data if publicly available.

sources.license_and_terms: University website terms/copyright not confirmed in this scratch pass; use as citation/link candidate.
sources.coverage_years: University news releases, including One Elmwood, Sustainable Energy Laboratory, Queen's Business School and Seamus Heaney Centre milestones.
sources.geographic_scope: Queen's University Belfast projects and programmes.
sources.granularity: Event-level news release with exact publication/opening dates.
sources.reliability_assessment: strong for official opening facts, with license caveat
sources.required_caveats: News may include promotional/value statements; extract observed opening/completion facts only.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use to refine exact event dates for QUB estates candidates.
next_checks: Pair with estates completed page for scope and completion month.
Avoid claims about current use unless the release explicitly states opening/use.

sources.source_name: Belfast City Council Planning Committee minutes and agendas
sources.license_and_terms: Public committee records on BCC minutes site; BCC copyright restrictions still apply to reuse of text.
sources.coverage_years: Planning committee records visible online; scratch candidates used 2024-2025 records.
sources.geographic_scope: Planning applications in Belfast City Council area.
sources.granularity: Application-level agenda/minute item, often with application ID, proposal description, meeting date and decision wording.
sources.reliability_assessment: strong for decision facts, not evidence of construction
sources.required_caveats: A planning permission is an administrative decision, not observed construction, completion, opening or current use.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Keep planning decisions as separate event type or candidate source; do not merge with built-change events unless later evidence confirms implementation.
next_checks: Resolve final decision notices through NI Planning Portal.
Use planning portal coordinates/site polygons where available.
Add negative checks to prevent treating approvals as completed works.

sources.license_and_terms: OpenStreetMap data is available under the Open Database Licence; Nominatim service has usage policy requirements. Coordinates in this scratch set are rounded approximate candidate points, not authoritative geometries.
sources.coverage_years: Current public map/geocoder snapshot; not a historical construction source.
sources.update_frequency: Continuously updated by OSM contributors; exact update timing varies.
sources.granularity: Address, feature or street-level geocoded point where available.
sources.required_caveats: Do not treat OSM edit dates as real-world change dates. Candidate coordinates may be approximate and should be replaced with official geometry.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Accept only as scratch geometry for candidate triage; production ingest should use official planning, asset or open data geometry.
next_checks: Record exact OSM object IDs if geocoding is retained.
Replace broad street midpoints with official parcel/site coordinates.
